source.integrity_rule: sha256 of downloaded archive must match GitHub release asset digest sha256:dd96df044a6e8538d5f423790f453bdd03d49e5b2bcc38214acc41a2f1297839 before use; no separate checksum file is published for v1.29.0

coverage: GitHub Actions workflow definitions under .github/workflows/*.yml and *.yaml collected via --collect=workflows, respecting .gitignore; honoring provider's default workflow collection semantics.
All audits applicable to workflows under the Regular persona and offline mode (template-injection, unpinned-uses, excessive-permissions, etc.); audits requiring online GitHub data are disabled.
known_exclusions: Composite action definitions (action.yml) are not collected in this slice's workflows-only mode.
Dependabot, pre-commit, and other non-workflow inputs are not collected in this slice.
Dockerfiles, Terraform, Kubernetes, application SAST, and dependency scanning are out of scope and belong to other controls.
Provider's pedantic-only audits and offline-disabled audits are not covered when using Regular persona and --offline.
limitations: Detection is bounded by the pinned provider's audit rule set and its configuration; absence of findings is not proof that no workflow weakness exists.

Provider default configuration and ignore comments apply unchanged unless disabled via --no-config; this slice uses --no-config to ensure repository-local configuration does not silently suppress findings.
Finding severities and confidences are as supplied by the provider; no additional severity remapping is performed.
Checksum integrity relies on GitHub-provided asset digest, not an independent publisher signature or separate checksum file (no such artifact is published for v1.29.0).
Workflow inventory certainty is required: zero workflows or indeterminate collection is BLOCKED, not PASS.
failure_cases: version output does not match the pinned provider version 1.29.0
downloaded archive sha256 does not match asset digest
provider exits non-zero without establishing findings, including partial scans
provider report missing or cannot be parsed as JSON array
collection yields no workflows (exit 3) or other provider error
